card.name: Inside disease terms like retinopathy
card.fires_on: Partway through or just after the start of a medical condition term, such as 'ret|in|opathy', 'fib|ros|ing colonopathy', 'inflammatory syndrome', or 'including inflammation' in the NSAID GI warning.

modes.label: Split disease words
modes.description: The middle piece of a long condition name such as retinopathy or fibrosing colonopathy.
modes.example: Monitor patients with a history of diabetic ret<<in>>opathy for progression.

modes.label: NSAID GI warning list
modes.description: The word 'inflammation' right after 'including' in the list of serious gastrointestinal events.
